status.description: DONE = spec fully implemented, tests executed and passing. BLOCKED = honest stop with named obstacle. No middle ground.

summary.description: What was implemented or the exact obstacle if BLOCKED

files_changed.description: Absolute paths of files created or modified

ran.description: True only if test runner was executed and its output was read

details.description: Raw test runner output (not a summary)

self_review.description: Skeptical self-review with confidence tags ([High]/[Medium]/[Low]/[Unknown]) on non-trivial claims

blocked_reason.description: Exact obstacle when status=BLOCKED; empty string when DONE
